task.name: cube_stack
task.description: Stack all the cubes into one tower: Use the right arm to pick up the five scattered cubes one at a time and place each on top of the growing stack; the left arm stays parked. Success condition: All actions completed in order, and all five cubes are stacked into a single free-standing tower with no cube left lying on the table.

substages.substage: 1. move right arm to a loose cube
3. lift the cube clear of the table
4. move the cube above the top of the stack
5. release the cube onto the stack
6. repeat for all remaining loose cubes
